History of:           ptahmigration/e2e-reachability-migration in namespace application
UID:                  reachability-uid
Created:              2026-11-06T18:28:29Z
Journal:              no entries, complete since 2026-11-06T18:28:33Z

The journal is the operator's own bounded record in status.journal, in the order
it recorded the entries, oldest first. It keeps at most 64 entries, none more
than 30 days older than the newest, and is not an audit archive. It is complete
from 2026-11-06T18:28:33Z, and an event before then may be missing. Entries
dated before it are ones the bounds keep, or ones dated by a time their status
carried from before it began. Each entry is dated by the status it was derived
from, so a time can be earlier than the entry above it. It is not the database's
revision table, which kubectl ptah migration e2e-reachability-migration
summarizes as its history read.

Approvals: none

Run acknowledgments: none

kubectl ptah migration e2e-reachability-migration -n application prints where it stands now.
kubectl events -n application --for ptahmigration/e2e-reachability-migration prints its Events, which Kubernetes keeps for about an hour.
